title: Month 3, Week 3 (Jan 17 – Jan 23, 2027): Adnexal/Merkel Skin Tumors, Cutaneous Lymphomas, Precursor/Myeloid/Histiocytic & Heme/Skin Mock

days.b1:
Retrieval (15m): Write out the AJCC 8th Ed. Melanoma T-stage cutoffs (T1 ≤1.0 mm, T2 >1.0–2.0 mm, T3 >2.0–4.0 mm, T4 >4.0 mm) and SLN Capsular Nevus vs. Melanoma IHC.
Reading (75m): WHO Skin 5th Ed. — Basal Cell Carcinoma (BerEP4+, BCL2 diffuse+, CD10 stromal-) vs. Trichoepithelioma (papillary mesenchymal bodies, CD10+ stroma, CK20+ Merkel cell colonizers!) vs. SCC (EMA+, p40+, BerEP4-); Sebaceous Neoplasms (Adipophilin+, AR+, EMA+; Muir-Torre MMR IHC: MSH2/MSH6/MLH1/PMS2); Cylindroma/Spiradenoma (CYLD), Syringoma, Microcystic Adnexal Carcinoma (perineural invasion), Pilomatricoma (CTNNB1, ghost cells), & Merkel Cell Carcinoma (CK20 paranuclear dot+, Neurofilament+, MCPyV+; TTF1-).
days.b2:
Spot Slides (15m): 5 Skin slides @ 3m/case (Morpheaform BCC, Trichoepithelioma, Sebaceous carcinoma, Cylindroma, Pilomatricoma, Merkel cell carcinoma).
QBank (30m): 15 Adnexal, Epidermal & Merkel Cell MCQs.
days.b3: SOE Deliverable: Log the classic board differential: Cutaneous Pagetoid Intraepidermal Malignancies ('P-B-S-M-M'): Paget disease (CK7+/GATA3+/HER2+), Bowen disease (p40+), Sebaceous carcinoma (AR+/Adipophilin+), Melanoma in situ (SOX10+/Melan-A+/PRAME+), and Mycosis fungoides (CD3+/CD4+).

days.b1:
Retrieval (15m): Recall the 5 Pagetoid Intraepidermal Malignancies ('P-B-S-M-M') and Merkel Cell Carcinoma vs. Metastatic SCLC IHC.
Reading (75m): Primary Cutaneous Lymphomas: Mycosis Fungoides (epidermotropism of haloed cerebriform lymphocytes without spongiosis, Pautrier microabscesses, wiry papillary dermal collagen; CD3+, CD4+, CD8-, loss of CD7; Large cell transformation >25% large cells); Cutaneous CD30+ LPDs (Lymphomatoid Papulosis vs. Primary Cutaneous ALCL); Subcutaneous Panniculitis-Like T-Cell Lymphoma (αβ TCR+, CD8+, adipocyte rimming, HAVCR2) vs. Primary Cutaneous γδ T-Cell Lymphoma (γδ TCR+, CD56+, hemophagocytosis); Cutaneous Follicle Center Lymphoma (BCL6+, BCL2-, lacks t(14;18)) vs. Cutaneous DLBCL, Leg Type (BCL2+, MUM1+, MYD88 L265P+).
days.b2:
Spot Slides (15m): 5 slides @ 3m/case (Mycosis fungoides, SPTCL rimming fat, Cutaneous follicle center lymphoma, Cutaneous DLBCL leg type, Cutaneous mastocytosis).
QBank (20m): 15 Cutaneous Lymphoma MCQs.
days.b3: SOE Deliverable: Log 4-Domain SOE entry on SPTCL (αβ TCR+, CD8+, Indolent) vs. Cutaneous Gamma-Delta T-Cell Lymphoma (γδ TCR+, CD56+, Aggressive) vs. Lupus Profundus (CD123+ plasmacytoid DCs, mucin, lymphoid follicles).

days.b1: Retrieval (15m): Compare Primary Cutaneous Follicle Center Lymphoma vs. Systemic Follicular Lymphoma Involving Skin vs. Primary Cutaneous DLBCL, Leg Type.
days.b2:
Slide Sprint (60m): 10 Timed Slides: 6 Cutaneous Lymphoma & Adnexal Spot Slides (3m/case) + 4 Serous Effusion & CSF Hematolymphoid Cytology Slides (Primary effusion lymphoma HHV8+, Burkitt in CSF, CLL vs. reactive pleural lymphocytosis @ 6m/case).
QBank (45m): 20 Cutaneous Lymphoma & Cyto MCQs.
days.b3: SOE Deliverable: Log the workup of a Lymphocyte-Rich Pleural Effusion (Flow cytometry triage; Primary Effusion Lymphoma is HHV8+, EBER+, CD45+, CD138+, CD30+, and negative for pan-B markers CD19/CD20!).

days.b1: Primary System — Precursor Lymphoblastic, Myeloid Sarcoma & Histiocytic/Dendritic Neoplasms (90m): WHO 5th Ed. — B-ALL/LBL (TdT+, PAX5+, CD19+, CD10+) & T-ALL/LBL (TdT+, cCD3+, CD1a/CD4/CD8+, CD99+); Myeloid Sarcoma (eosinophilic myelocytes; MPO+, Lysozyme+, CD117+, CD34+, CD43+, CD68+); BPDCN (skin bruise-like plaques; CD4+, CD56+, CD123+, TCL1+, TCF4+); & Histiocytic/Dendritic Neoplasms: LCH (BRAF V600E, CD1a+, Langerin+, S100+), Erdheim-Chester (foamy Touton histiocytes, Factor XIIIa+, CD68+, CD1a-), Follicular Dendritic Cell Sarcoma (CD21+, CD23+, CD35+, CXCL13+, Clusterin+), & Interdigitating Dendritic Cell Sarcoma (S100+, SOX10+, CD1a-, CD21-).
days.b2: QBank & Slides (30m): 15 Myeloid/Histiocytic/Dendritic MCQs + 5 Spot Slides (Myeloid sarcoma, BPDCN, LCH, Follicular dendritic cell sarcoma, Erdheim-Chester).
days.b3: SOE Deliverable: Log the surgical pathology trap: CD43-Positive Undifferentiated Sheet-Like Tumor (If CD43+ but CD20- and CD3-, always stain for MPO, Lysozyme, CD117, CD34, and CD68 to catch Myeloid Sarcoma!).

days.b1: Retrieval (15m): Compare LCH vs. Rosai-Dorfman vs. Erdheim-Chester vs. Follicular Dendritic Cell Sarcoma vs. Interdigitating Dendritic Cell Sarcoma (IHC & EM).
days.b2:
QBank Sprint (60m): 30 Timed MCQs (15 Melanocytic/Cutaneous Lymphoma/Myeloid + 15 2015–2023 Trainee Recalls on Dermpath, Melanoma SLN, Cutaneous Lymphomas & Histiocytic Tumors).
Deep Review (45m): Dissect recall answer explanations.
days.b3: SOE Deliverable: Add missed Dermpath & Histiocytic recall traps into your 4-Domain SOE Log.

days.b2: (Optional) 30m review of Week 3 SOE Log entries.
days.b3: Click Push to sync Week 3 of Month 3 to GitHub.

days.b1: Hematopathology & Dermatopathology Consolidation + Pitfalls (2.5h): Complete review of Month 3 One-Pagers 1–4 + SCFHS Curriculum Heme Pitfalls (Crush artifact in small biopsies, CD20 loss after Rituximab therapy requiring PAX5/CD79a/CD19, Mohs frozen section artifacts in BCC vs. hair follicles).
days.b2: Heme & Dermpath Mastery Mini-Mock (90m): 20 Timed Heme & Dermpath Virtual Spot Slides (60m @ 3m/case) + 30 Timed Heme, Flow Cytometry & Dermpath MCQs (30m).
days.b3: SOE Deliverable (30m): Update your Hematopathology & Dermatopathology Confidence Sliders in Tab 4 (Target: 2/5 -> 3.5/5) and run a 20m SOE station on a Cutaneous Melanoma Excision + Sentinel Lymph Node.
